title: Compare the length of two strings
description:
Write a function `compare_name_lengths(first_name, last_name)` that returns a tuple `(len(first_name), len(last_name), longer)`, where `longer` is `'first_name'`, `'last_name'`, or `'equal'`.

Covers source items 2-3 (find the length of your first name with `len()`, then compare it to your last name's length) as one exercise.
hints: len(first_name) and len(last_name) give the two lengths directly; comparing them with < and > tells you which is longer.
Compute both lengths, decide 'first_name', 'last_name', or 'equal' based on comparing them, and return all three as a tuple.
expected_behavior: Returns (first_name length, last_name length, which one is longer).
explanation: len() measures characters, not visual width or anything language-specific - the comparison after it is a plain if/elif/else on two integers.
